_comment: Work-status answers that must be TRUE for the person. Profiles = [work_authorized_us, needs_sponsorship]; null = not on file. Expected: 'Yes' / 'No' / '' (blank -> hand back). Read by chrome-extension/tests/work-status.test.js AND tests/test_screener_policy.py: browser and server must agree.
